item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single 2024 document showing Trọng personally building a meritocratic team across both the party-state and government. The best evidence is fragmented: discipline and security appointments are clear, technocratic empowerment is visible in some institutions, but the anti-graft purge also created churn and fear. After July 18, 2024, direct attribution to Trọng falls off materially, so late-year personnel outcomes are mostly attributable to the succession machine rather than him personally.","evidence":[{"title":"Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan","publisher":"Government of Viet Nam","date":"2024-01-08","url":"https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm","summary":"The 2024 economic plan set concrete priorities on macro stability, inflation control, legislative reform, and state-budget management. This supports a reading that Trọng’s system was still able to place capable policy hands around a structured program.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Vietnam names acting president after legislature votes to remove Thuong","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-03-21","url":"https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-names-acting-president-after-legislature-votes-to-remove-thuong/2009559/","summary":"The removal of a top official amid the anti-graft drive shows Trọng empowering enforcers and using party discipline to replace compromised elites. It is evidence of personnel control, though the selection logic was political rather than technocratic.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Vietnam Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-04-19","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/","summary":"The Politburo punished a minister for failures under his leadership, and Reuters said hundreds of officials and executives were already being prosecuted. This is strong evidence that Trọng empowered disciplinary enforcers, but it also shows that parts of the bureaucracy were poorly managed.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Toàn văn phát biểu của Tổng Bí thư Nguyễn Phú Trọng gửi Hội nghị Quân ủy Trung ương","publisher":"Government of Viet Nam","date":"2024-07-08","url":"https://baochinhphu.vn/toan-van-phat-bieu-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-gui-hoi-nghi-quan-uy-trung-uong-102240708183856132.htm","summary":"The July 8 speech gave concrete direction to the military and defense apparatus, showing Trọng still trying to empower loyal security officials to carry out the program. This is stronger on coercive capacity than on expert recruitment.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.1"]},{"title":"Plan for implementing the Social Insurance Law 2024","publisher":"Viet Nam Social Security","date":"2024-11-26","url":"https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375","summary":"The implementation plan created a steering group, assigned responsibilities, set a roadmap, and ordered inspection and guidance. This is good evidence that the apparatus was being staffed and organized for execution, though not necessarily by Trọng personally after July 18.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Audit standards of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam 2024","publisher":"State Audit Office of Viet Nam","date":"2024","url":"https://sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=261&l=News","summary":"The audit office issued 43 standards and tied its work to professionalism, honesty, objectivity, openness, and transparency. This is strong evidence of empowering a capable oversight institution, but it remains a party-state institution rather than an independent meritocratic check.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Vietnam’s anti-graft campaign caused administrative paralysis","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint / Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-05-17 and 2024-05-20","url":"https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/ and https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/","summary":"Reuters reported delayed approvals, lost aid, upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy. This is the strongest counterevidence that Trọng was not consistently empowering competent administrators; the campaign often damaged state capacity.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"Nguyen Phu Trong, who led Vietnam’s outreach and crackdowns, dies at 80","publisher":"The Washington Post","date":"2024-07-19","url":"https://www.washingtonpost.com/obituaries/2024/07/19/nguyen-phu-trong-vietnam-dies/","summary":"Reuters/AP’s obituary gives the best mixed synthesis: anti-corruption and economic dynamism on one side, but tighter state control and politicized discipline on the other. That fits a pattern of empowering loyal operators and coercive administrators more than neutral professionals.","question_ids":["8B.4","7B.10","8B.3"]},{"title":"Vietnam’s top leader Trọng dies at 80, party says","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-07-19","url":"https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/","summary":"Reuters said his duties were transferred on July 18 because of illness, so his direct control ended before the second half of 2024. That sharply limits confidence in any full-year claim that Trọng personally selected or empowered people after mid-July.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.2","8B.3"]}]}
